name: Way Speed
description: One LiDAR sensor beside the track returns a full sprint velocity curve and automatic splits after every rep.

name: Stat Jump
description: Turns a phone video of your volleyball approach and jump into numbers you can train against.

name: Photo Painter
description: An e-ink photo frame running my own firmware. A phone app dithers photos to the six-color screen, and the frame pulls the next one from the cloud on a schedule.
